_comment: Elevation test scene (T-182). Flat-world units, x east, y south. Every number is a proposal for the board's playtest. A platform is an axis-aligned rectangle with a height; a ramp is a rectangle next to a platform side it climbs (north/east/south/west), rising from bottom_height at its far end to top_height at the platform. Every platform side without a ramp is a drop-off.
